commits.message:
Place batch 205: six K215 proof-simplification packets, retire 6 archives

The six packets of a6b3a30011 propose shorter K215 proofs. Each is placed
whole and byte-identical under k225-formal/verification/k215/simplification/
proposals/ (logs, TeX auxiliaries and checksum lists stay out by the ignore
rules), omitting only copies of repository files (zfc-k215-transport/
reference/, fm215-compression machine/inherited_notices/ and machine/tables/).
proposals/README.md indexes them with their status against main:
- realized: the single Lean source certificate (RMOffsetBisim.OBisim.symm);
- open: the single-certificate Rocq source proof with a compact path codec
  (zfc215-simplification/source_proof/Source215Simple.v, Coq 8.18), the
  trailing-zero quotient of the Lean certificate (2,240 -> 1,426,
  k215-simplification), the calibration round-trip patch (structural), and
  shared decoder contexts for KSites215 (fm215-compression, structural);
- CM215 <-> K215 and M124 <-> K215 transport proofs (positive stuttering),
  compiled standalone, are formal endpoints for those alternatives once
  their adapters compile.

The only new 215-state table, FM215, differs from batch 204's M124 in one
row (127/1 -> 109 instead of 59), so it was not placed as an alternative.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Place batch 206: revised K215 proof-simplification packet, retire its archive

K215_Proof_Simplification_2026-10-21 (2).zip (arrival 53269bcab1) differs from batch 205's archive of the same name: coq/ proves symmetry for the actual offset checker and the compact/original certificate equality (Coq 8.18, coqchk), plain_source/ checks the ordinary zero-offset source equivalence in Lean (70 modules), formal_cm215/ transports CM215 to KDense215.machine215. All its tables are already in the repository. Placed whole and byte-identical as k225-formal/verification/k215/simplification/proposals/k215-simplification-2/ (logs stay out by the ignore rules), indexed in proposals/README.md; nothing rerun; the queue is clear.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Place batch 207: third K215 proof-simplification packet, retire its archive

K215_Proof_Simplification_2026-10-21(1).zip (arrival beaabc8e3b): finite replays and uncompiled drafts for the K215 endpoints (equal 1,426-node increment-count CFGs of the two source programs, ordered CFGs differing by 256 adjacent increment swaps from two DAG templates, canonical checkpoint rows, packed Rocq certificate and Lean symmetry/canonical-row drafts, a comparison of alternatives). Placed byte-identical as k225-formal/verification/k215/simplification/proposals/k215-simplification-3/, omitting lean/snapshot/ (730 files mirroring this repository) and new_intake/gc_zc215/received.zip (batch 204's archive); logs stay out by the ignore rules. Its only table not in the repository, common-pop215, is a comparison input from an undelivered packet with no proof here, not placed as an alternative. Nothing rerun; the queue is clear.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
